pages.text: A wand learns its wielder. Every spell you cast while holding one counts toward its $(l)mastery$(), and the wand remembers, whoever holds it next.$(br2)At each milestone it takes a new name and a new look, and the spells you cast through it grow a little cheaper and quicker to recharge.
pages.title: Wands That Grow

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Attuned$(): 40 casts$(li)$(l)Resonant$(): 120$(li)$(l)Empowered$(): 300$(li)$(l)Ascendant$(): 600$(li)$(l)Mythic$(): 1,000$(br2)Each level: spells cost $(l)2%$() less mana and recharge $(l)3%$() faster (10% and 15% at Mythic). All three wands grow this way.
pages.title: Milestones
